The main takeaway from our work is that
sexual reproduction can be restored in industrial strains of Trichoderma species and that the mating type locus is not the only factor limiting sexual reproduction in industrial strains.
the sexual life cycle of filamentous fungi can be restored in industrial strains by the introduction of a few genes.
sexual crossing can be achieved in T. reesi with QM6-like strains and that this is not only a theoretical possibility but can be achieved in practice.
